headline: Lionel Messi hints at retirement after father's passing
summary: The football legend shares an emotional message for his father, while Cristiano Ronaldo sends a message of strength.
details: Lionel Messi has expressed deep grief following the death of his father. The football superstar shared an emotional message, stating that his father left too soon.
In the wake of this personal tragedy, Messi has reportedly hinted at the possibility of retirement from professional football.
Cristiano Ronaldo, Messi's long-time rival and peer, has reached out to the Argentine star with a message of strength and support during this difficult time.
Messi's father played a significant role in his early career and life, making this loss a profound blow to the athlete.

headline_marked: Trump claims [[Hormuz Strait is under control]]
headline: Trump claims Hormuz Strait is under control
summary: The former US President stated that the strategic waterway is now secure, attributing the success to divine praise.
details: Donald Trump has claimed that the Strait of Hormuz is now under control. He expressed his gratitude, stating, 'All praise be to Allah,' while discussing the strategic waterway.
The Strait of Hormuz is one of the most critical chokepoints in the world for global oil shipments, making its security a high priority for international trade and maritime safety.
This statement comes amid ongoing regional tensions in the Middle East, where control over the waterway has often been a point of geopolitical conflict.
The claim of control over the Strait of Hormuz is likely to draw attention to US influence in the region and the strategic goals of the volonté of the former president.
